_readme: Video-model behaviour and prices drift week to week. Every rule and model entry below was last checked on the date it carries; treat older entries as hypotheses and re-check against GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/videos/models (and a real paid probe for behaviour) before a big run. est_usd_per_second feeds --dry-run and --max-usd only; the real cost of each clip is read from the API and written to its sidecar.

rules.reason: A shot that must lip-sync to the song keeps the real vocal best on Hailuo 3. Seedance 2.5 audio references re-sang unreliably or ignored the song on wide shots.
rules.note: OBSERVATION from one project on 2026-10-10, not a guarantee. Without --audio-refs a singing shot is generated silent on the same model and the mouth will not match; the cut lays the original song over it anyway.

rules.reason: Seedance 2.5 refused photoreal human faces (400 InputImageSensitiveContentDetected.PrivacyInformation, 'may contain real person'). Silent human-face shots go to Seedance 1.5 Pro (first frame only). Use Hailuo 3 instead if you want more motion or need the face in a song-synced shot.
rules.note: Refusals were per image, not per character. Re-prompting the shot as 'fictional' did not help. Filters tighten over time; re-test with a real submit.

rules.reason: Non-human, robot and faceless shots passed the Seedance 2.5 filter and it gave the most energetic motion.
rules.note: Same caveat: per-image filter. Set a shot's face to 'human' and re-run if a creature frame is refused.

minimax/hailuo-3.label: Hailuo 3
minimax/hailuo-3.price_note: about $0.13/s plus about $0.04 per reference image; 2K output only (omit the resolution field). Checked 2026-10-10.
minimax/hailuo-3.notes: Needs an image reference when given audio. Kept the sung vocal on the wide-band shots where Seedance 2.5 did not. Accepted a human face where Seedance 2.5 refused.

bytedance/seedance-2.5.label: Seedance 2.5
bytedance/seedance-2.5.price_note: token-priced; roughly $0.10/s at 480p and $0.23/s at 720p by token arithmetic. Checked 2026-10-10.
bytedance/seedance-2.5.notes: Audio works only when the keyframe is sent as input_references. Pinning it as first_frame silently drops the audio. Refuses some photoreal human faces. Camera moves on wide band shots can hallucinate a duplicate character.

bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro.label: Seedance 1.5 Pro
bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro.price_note: about $0.13 per 5 s clip at 720p, silent. Checked 2026-10-10.
bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro.notes: First and last frame only, no audio input. Passed the face filter on human faces in the 2026-10-10 test.

heygen/heygen-video-1.label: HeyGen Video 1
heygen/heygen-video-1.notes: Cheapest model found that keeps a vocal; motion was stiffer than the others. Not in the routing rules; use it with a per-shot 'model' override or --model.

kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro.label: Kling 3 Pro
kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro.notes: Held character identity well; rejects audio references. Good silent story shots.

google/veo-3.1-fast.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
google/veo-3.1-fast.notes: Drifted character identity in the 2026-10-10 test. Listed so the dry run can price it, not as a recommendation.
